_meta.description: Hand-curated X (Twitter) posts, newest first. Each post is printed as a ruled row (date, author, text); X's script loads only when a reader asks for one full post with its photos. 'status' grades the post's claims, not the account: posts by enthusiasts are 'reported' at best. Dates come from the post ID.

posts.text: Mumbai Metro line 12 First PPC (Precast Prestressed Concrete) Platform level erection for a metro station on Line 12. Station name undisclosed. (PCRO)

posts.author: Arindam Mahapatra
posts.text: MMRDA has issued 2 separate tenders for various works related to construction of 11 stations of Line 12 between Kalyan and Katai Naka.
posts.notes: Lead: names Katai Naka as a Line 12 station. Not in the station list until the tender document is found.

posts.author: Swarup Bodke
posts.text: MMRDA has invited bids for architectural finishing, roof sheeting, external facade, water supply, sanitary installation and drainage for 6 stations of Mumbai Metro Line 12: Dombivali MIDC, Sagaon, Sonarpada, Manpada, Kolegaon, Katai Naka.
posts.notes: Original is in capitals; written in sentence case for the fallback.

posts.text: MMRDA has invited bids for architectural finishing, roof sheeting, external facade, water supply, sanitary installation and drainage for 5 stations of Mumbai Metro Line 12: Kalyan, APMC Kalyan, Ganesh Nagar, Pisavali Gaon, Golavali.

posts.text: August 2026 update of Metro 12 between Kalyan and Kharghar (Amandoot). 1st LHS-RHS pillar casting work has started near Amandoot metro station (Pic 3). Supporting structures in station area has been cleared.
